localStripEconomy.base: H12/150 each face/two axes; add offset H12/150 each face only in the actual span direction at governing >0.30mm regions, resulting local75 rather than pretending to make 100 from 150. Includes650 beyond both receiving faces and 150 side extension clipped to real slab; boundary bars still require hook/anchorage. localStripEconomy.decision: Simpler uniform100 is the bounded reproducible control. Compare this lower-mass reinforcement layout for actual cover/joint/scheduling rather than declaring dense steel a whole-house invariant.

structuralFloorComparison.crackMethod: JRC Eurocode 2 worked examples, 2014, 7.3.4 form sr=3.4c+0.8*k2*0.425*bar/rhoeff. Deliberately neglect favourable tension-stiffening, full G+Q elastic cracked stress plus a separate 400microstrain upper restraint comparison using pure-tension k2=1.0. The 0.30mm is an authored structural comparison only, not acceptable gas transmission, liquid permeability or proof of lifetime crack width. Full restraint, unmodeled settlement and thermal exposure remain bounded hypotheses. https://eurocodes.jrc.ec.europa.eu/publications/eurocode-2-background-appications-design-concrete-buildings-worked-examples
structuralFloorComparison.pour: Preferred finite construction control: form a continuous upper200mm dry-floor lift (20.98m3 nominal), including the head/beam overlap once and the formed threshold seat. No planned full-depth intermediate joint in occupied field; if the lower grillage is cast first, structural horizontal construction interface is at underside -380 with prepared rough concrete and continuing reinforcement. Starter/interlock, real pour length, temperature/early-age restraint, interruption detail and any service penetrations still need coordinated design. Do not declare the construction joint airtight.
structuralFloorComparison.materials: C30/S500 only structural comparison. Composite RC density at or below25kN/m3 including the actual bars must be delivered for this load bound. Cement dose, constituent mix, permeability, curing, floor surface/air-wall seal and actual site/water exposure remain the material/source owners’ duties. 300kg/m3 or 40mm exposure hypothesis alone gives no admission.
structuralFloorComparison.scope: Only candidate thickness/cover comparisons. Actual mix, curing, crack/joint moisture/air/gas performance, floor/wall and renewable threshold construction remain unearned.

control.role: Ordinary dry-side air-control development control, not an actual seal/product or pressure-water closure
control.rule: Steady laminar parallel-plate calculation derived from pressure-driven momentum balance; uniform connected gap, no slip, constant properties. Ideal straight-channel sensitivity only, not a measured joint rating or an adopted allocation. Entrance, roughness, variable gap and end bypass remain actual assembly matters.
control.waterDuty: No source-qualified head assigned to this dry apron behind crest15. Quiet water -35 and geometric crest15 are not a first-leak rating; firstSusceptible remains null. No closed E roof/pipe pressure duty is transferred. Water/capillary/end qualification remains independent.
control.toleranceRole: The2mm movement and1mm edge tolerances are authored challenge bounds, not actual fabrication/installation tolerances. Gap control is an unproven requirement on formed faces and supports, not an achieved fit.
control.ends: No actual end gap or end closure is authored. Every gap result is central only and cannot be credited as total assembly leakage.
control.renewal: Ordinary retention/cover must be independently supported and entirely released before NORTH500 withdrawal; no permanent field-to-pan weld or through-pan fixing. No high preload is inferred from air duty alone.

ordinaryThresholdAirComparison.recommendation: Do not specify a high-force vacuum-style seal from a circular catalogue. First test an ordinary supported overlap or replaceable compression interface against actual air duty, with independent water/capillary/end/movement and walking qualification.
